message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. The first blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so admin_dc and admin_adfs remain false. The second then blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique even if database administrator credentials are stolen. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-server credential-leak route open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administrator access. Any other single control leaves the phishing → internal access → server authentication → stolen administrator credentials → DC/ADFS → data-store exfiltration route available. With segmented alone, an unpatched workstation or laptop supplies the administrator access needed to pivot internally."}
